name: Jer'kai's Signet Ring
summary: Jer'kai's Signet Ring carries her message from the wilds of Feralas to Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus. It tells the High Priestess that Jer'kai and Kindal are well and gives credit for your help.

sections.title: A Message to Darnassus
sections.body: In Feralas, Jer'kai Moonweaver entrusts you with her signet ring after you help her and Kindal. She asks you to carry it to Tyrande Whisperwind at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. The ring bears word that the two are well and gives Tyrande the truth of your help.

sections.title: At the Temple
sections.body: Tyrande hears your account of helping dragonkind and one of her priestesses. She promises to return Jer'kai's ring, sending scouts toward Feralas with it. For now, the ring has carried its message to the High Priestess.

faq.q: What is Jer'kai's Signet Ring for?
faq.answer: Jer'kai asks you to take the ring to Tyrande Whisperwind at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. It tells Tyrande that Jer'kai and Kindal are well and gives credit for your help.
Jer'kai Moonweaver gives you her signet ring in Feralas after you help her and Kindal.

faq.q: Who is supposed to receive the ring?
faq.answer: Tyrande Whisperwind, the High Priestess at Darnassus's Temple of the Moon, is to receive the ring.

faq.q: What does Tyrande do with the ring?
faq.answer: Tyrande promises to return the ring to Jer'kai, sending scouts toward Feralas with it.

angles.text: As a night elf, you carry Jer'kai's message to Tyrande Whisperwind, High Priestess of Elune, at the Temple of the Moon.
